cat > /tmp/writable_ws/parse_redirect.py << 'EOF'
import sys
import importlib.util
import os

class ParseRedirectFinder:
    def find_module(self, fullname, path=None):
        if fullname == 'parse':
            return self
        
    def load_module(self, fullname):
        if fullname in sys.modules:
            return sys.modules[fullname]
        
        # Load from our modified location
        module_path = '/tmp/writable_ws/parse.py'
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(fullname, module_path)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        sys.modules[fullname] = module
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        return module

# Install the finder at the front of sys.meta_path
sys.meta_path.insert(0, ParseRedirectFinder())
EOF
